note: The Central Bank of The Gambia's table of each bank's selected fees and charges (September 2025, the latest it publishes): a savings account is charged only on closing and, at two banks, for falling below a minimum; Trust Bank (TBL) has no minimum-balance charge, so its savings account costs nothing to keep. Current accounts pay ledger fees per thousand dalasi of debits, which the game doesn't count.
